import java.util.*;

public class MinCostFlow {
    static final int INF = 1034567890;
    static final int MAX_NODE = 100000;
    static final int MAX_EDGE = 1000000;

    static class Edge {
        int to, capacity, cost, type;
        Edge(int t, int c, int v, int ty) {
            this.to = t;
            this.capacity = c;
            this.cost = v;
            this.type = ty;
        }
    }

    static List<Integer>[] adj = new ArrayList[MAX_NODE];
    static Edge[] edges = new Edge[MAX_EDGE];
    static int edgeCount;
    static int sink;
    static int C, d;

    static int[] minCost = new int[MAX_NODE];
    static int[] dist = new int[MAX_NODE];
    static int[] queue = new int[MAX_NODE * 10];
    static int[] inQueue = new int[MAX_NODE];

    static void clearFlow(int sinkNode) {
        sink = sinkNode;
        for (int i = 0; i <= sink; i++) {
            adj[i].clear();
        }
        edgeCount = 0;
    }

    static void addEdge(int from, int to, int capacity, int cost, int type) {
        adj[from].add(edgeCount);
        edges[edgeCount] = new Edge(to, capacity, cost, type);
        edgeCount++;
        adj[to].add(edgeCount);
        if (type == 1) {
            edges[edgeCount] = new Edge(from, 0, -C + d, type);
            edgeCount++;
        } else {
            edges[edgeCount] = new Edge(from, 0, -cost, type);
            edgeCount++;
        }
    }

    static int flow() {
        Arrays.fill(minCost, 0, sink + 1, INF);
        Arrays.fill(inQueue, 0, sink + 1, 0);
        minCost[sink] = INF;
        int front = 0, rear = 1;
        queue[0] = 0;
        minCost[0] = 0;
        while (front < rear) {
            int u = queue[front++];
            inQueue[u] = 0;
            for (int r : adj[u]) {
                int v = edges[r].to;
                if (edges[r].capacity > 0 && minCost[u] + edges[r].cost < minCost[v]) {
                    minCost[v] = minCost[u] + edges[r].cost;
                    if (inQueue[v] == 0) {
                        inQueue[v] = 1;
                        queue[rear++] = v;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (minCost[sink] == INF) return -1;
        int current = sink;
        while (current != 0) {
            int r = 0;
            for (int idx : adj[current]) {
                if (edges[idx].to == current && edges[idx ^ 1].capacity > 0 && minCost[current] == minCost[edges[idx].to] + edges[idx].cost) {
                    r = idx;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (edges[r].type == 1) {
                if ((r & 1) == 1) {
                    edges[r].cost += 2 * d;
                    edges[r ^ 1].cost -= 2 * d;
                } else {
                    edges[r].cost += 2 * d;
                    edges[r ^ 1].cost -= 2 * d;
                }
            }
            edges[r].capacity--;
            edges[r ^ 1].capacity++;
            current = edges[r ^ 1].to;
        }
        return minCost[sink];
    }

    static int solve(int n) {
        int total = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int f = flow();
            if (f == -1) break;
            total += f;
        }
        return total;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        C = sc.nextInt();
        d = sc.nextInt();

        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_NODE; i++) {
            adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        clearFlow(n * 100 + 1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            addEdge(0, x, 1, 0, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= 99; i++) {
            addEdge(1 + i * n, 100 * n + 1, INF, 0, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= 99; j++) {
                addEdge(i + (j - 1) * n, i + j * n, INF, C, 0);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            int y = sc.nextInt();
            for (int j = 1; j <= 99; j++) {
                addEdge(x + (j - 1) * n, y + j * n, INF, C + d, 1);
                addEdge(y + (j - 1) * n, x + j * n, INF, C + d, 1);
            }
        }
        System.out.println(solve(k));
        sc.close();
    }
}
